# Capture Documentation

> bitdrift Capture is a cost-effective dynamic observability platform for mobile applications. It provides a lightweight SDK for iOS, Android, and React Native that enables high-volume local telemetry storage with selective, real-time-controlled uploads. The platform includes Instant Insights dashboards, Workflows for custom metrics, Session Timeline for debugging, Issues & Crashes tracking, and Alerts.

- The Capture SDK is available for Android, iOS, and React Native
- Workflows are the core building block for custom metrics, funnels, and session capture rules
- The platform is controlled via a web portal at bitdrift.io and a CLI tool (`bd`)
- The API uses schema-first protobuf service definitions with Connect and gRPC transports

## Docs

- [Capture Documentation](https://docs.bitdrift.io/index.md)
- [Capture Quickstart](https://docs.bitdrift.io/quickstart.md)
